title: eng-ml
text:
eng-ml

Carla M: Quick sync — proposing we pin ember-3b to catalog as ember-3b@v1 during the quiet window tomorrow 21:00 UTC. Planning: 5% canary for 15m, then full pin if smoke good. Who's on deploy and rollback?
Dave R: I can run the deploy and watch the infra side. I'll be on call 20:30-22:30 UTC.
Alice K: I will own smoke tests + perf checks. I'll post the smoke checklist in a sec.
Ben S: 5% canary sounds right. Will monitor p99 latency and error rate. If anything > 10% regression we roll back.
Eve L: I'll validate model outputs against the eval set (QA prompts) and watch for hallucination regressions.
Carla M: @Dave R can you confirm the rollback plan? quick commands and the alias to flip back if needed?
Dave R: Rollback plan: 1) flip catalog alias to ember-3b@v0, 2) remove canary routing, 3) restart canary workers if stuck. Command I use: `redwood catalog pin --model ember-3b --version v0 --force` (will run from ops box).
Alice K: Smoke checklist (short):
```
- healthcheck /metrics on model instances
- run 100 inference prompts (mix of short/long) from smoke set
- check token latency p50/p95/p99 vs baseline
- sample 20 outputs to QA channel
```
Ben S: I'll set a short Grafana dashboard panel with the canary filter and share link once up.
Carla M: deploy-bot, please queue the pin request to start at 21:00 UTC and notify when canary hits 5%.
deploy-bot: catalog service — pin request received for ember-3b@v1. Scheduled: 2025-03-19 21:00 UTC. Will ack at canary start.
Eve L: If canary passes at 15m, what's the cooldown before full flip? want to give QA 10m to review samples.
Carla M: agree — plan: 15m canary + 10m QA hold, then full pin. Total ~25m.
Dave R: I'll be ready to flip back within 5m if we see issues. Leave deploy channel open.
Alice K: I'll post a short pass/fail in 03-ember thread and tag folks.
Ben S: +1. I'll watch infra metrics and do a quick traffic replay if numbers look off.
Carla M: Thanks all — tagging the owners: deploy=Dave R, smoke=Alice K, perf=Ben S, QA=Eve L. Ping here when you start. :thumbsup:
